answer: Treat each network origin as a wharf: the ledger notes which ASN and /24 prefix carries every identity's answers, and the k-th key paid from one wharf in an epoch earns 1/k. A 100-key farm on one cloud host collects ~5.2 shares, not 100. Spreading out means renting distinct residential prefixes; assuming $3/month per sticky IP, 100 full-pay clones cost $300/month before compute. A moved key regains share at glacier pace, 10% per epoch, and a raven-eyed audit flags keys that hop prefixes together.
